judgements.justification: A's AC held the central clustering claim, shown only on a linearized sub-network, as 'remains speculative' for the real network and gave a poster, while B's AC restated the abstract's claims at face value and gave a spotlight.
Neither committee's reviewers were unsure and flat: A rated 5/7/6 at confidence 5/4/3 and B 6/7/6 at the same confidences, with confident reviewers on both sides.
